title: Optimal Covariate Adjustment beyond the Average Treatment Effect: Treated-Population and Overlap-Weighted Estimands
abstract: arXiv:2609.11222v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graphical causal inference supplies a complete theory of efficient covariate adjustment for the average treatment effect: one adjustment set, computable from the graph, is optimal under every compatible distribution. We show that this is a property of the average treatment effect's inverse-prevalence weights, not of causal estimands in general. For the average treatment effect on the treated we index the efficiency bound by the adjustment set and derive exact identities for its change under treatment-side and outcome-side extensions of a valid set. translated_title: 超越平均处理效应的最优协变量调整：处理人群与重叠加权估计量
translated_abstract: 图因果推断为平均处理效应的高效协变量调整提供了完整的理论：一个可从图中计算得到的调整集，在所有兼容分布下都是最优的。我们证明这是平均处理效应的逆流行率权重的性质，而非一般因果估计量的性质。对于处理组平均处理效应，我们以调整集为效率界编制索引，并推导出在有效集的处理侧和结果侧扩展下效率界变化的精确恒等式。仅预测处理组结果的协变量恰好是效率中性的，而当倾向得分低于二分之一时，预测对照组结果的协变量可能严格增加效率界——这是补充引理的一个逆转，其根源是一个对平均处理效应成立但对处理人群估计量不成立的算术-几何平均不等式。
tldr: 本文证明平均处理效应的最优协变量调整理论源于其逆流行率权重而非因果估计量的一般性质，并为处理组平均处理效应推导出效率界随调整集扩展变化的精确恒等式，揭示预测对照组结果的协变量在倾向得分低于二分之一时会严格增大效率界。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that the complete theory of optimal covariate adjustment for the average treatment effect stems from its inverse-prevalence weights rather than a general property of causal estimands, and derives exact identities for how the efficiency bound of the average treatment effect on the treated changes under adjustment set extensions, revealing that covariates predicting the control-arm outcome can strictly increase the bound when the propensity is below one half.
